title: Name or hide inline graphics
why: An inline SVG or canvas without an accessible name, fallback, or explicit decorative role can expose an unexplained graphic to assistive technology.
suggestion: Give meaningful graphics an aria-label, aria-labelledby reference, SVG title, or canvas fallback; mark decorative graphics aria-hidden or role=presentation.
limitations: The rule checks native inline SVG and canvas elements in HTML, HTM, and Svelte files; framework components, uppercase Svelte components, and graphics created by scripts are not treated as native elements.

Literal accessible attributes, dynamic ARIA label bindings, SVG title content, canvas fallback text, labelled ancestors, SVG symbol-definition containers, and Svelte graphics forwarding spread attributes are accepted.
